rows.sourceExample: A discount can nudge people towards a purchase.
rows.sourceMeaning: Influence choices gently; a physical push metaphor.
rows.canonicalMeaning: Gently or subtly influence someone towards a choice or course of action.

rows.sourceExample: The school is using less chalk-and-talk teaching.
rows.sourceMeaning: Teacher-led instruction focused on board work and explanation; a conventional education term.

The science department reduced chalk-and-talk teaching by adding laboratory demonstrations.
negative: The teacher drew a chalk line on the pavement.

rows.sourceExample: Travel writing is their cup of tea.
rows.sourceMeaning: Something they personally enjoy; a fixed beverage idiom.
rows.canonicalMeaning: A personal preference: affirmative be someone’s cup of tea means they enjoy it; the negative form means they do not or that tastes differ.
rows.newPattern: (?:\bnot (?:everyone[’']s|my|your|his|her|our|their) cup of tea\b)|(?:\b(?:is|are|was|were) (?:my|your|his|her|our|their) cup of tea\b)
positive: Travel writing is their cup of tea.
Local history is her cup of tea, so she volunteered to guide the archive tour.
negative: The café served her a cup of tea.
